{{short description|Canadian mathematician and computer scientist}}
'''Wendy Joanne Myrvold''' is a Canadian mathematician and computer scientist known for her work on [[graph algorithm]]s, [[planarity testing]], and algorithms in [[enumerative combinatorics]]. She is a professor emeritus of computer science at the [[University of Victoria]].{{r|em}}

Myrvold completed her Ph.D. in 1988 at the [[University of Waterloo]]. Her dissertation, ''The Ally and Adversary Reconstruction Problems'', was supervised by [[Charles Colbourn]].{{r|mg}}
